Irish footballer Jack Moylan lifts and kisses his black armband after scoring the team's third goal against Israel. 

Irish players wore the armbands in recognition of the lives lost in Gaza. Ireland won the match 3-0. https://t.co/mZ94VWticT

Ireland team football players donned black armbands to pay tribute to the dead in the Gaza genocide, and bowed their heads during the Israeli national anthem during their match against Israel. https://t.co/AUiWnOejSb
